spec.title: Log volume by source
spec.description: Log lines per interval, split by source.

spec.title: Errors and warnings
spec.description: Error and warning lines per interval.

spec.title: Top hosts by error volume
spec.description: Hosts with the most error lines.

spec.title: Top hosts by log volume
spec.description: Hosts generating the most log lines.

spec.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Ban " [$__range]))) / (sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Ban " [$__range])) + sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Unban " [$__range]))) * 100

(sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Unban " [$__range]))) / (sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Ban " [$__range])) + sum(count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] Unban " [$__range]))) * 100

spec.title: Lines by source
spec.description: Share of log volume per source.

spec.title: Errors by source
spec.description: Share of error lines per source.

spec.title: Warnings by host
spec.description: Share of warning lines per host.

spec.title: Auth failures by host
spec.description: Failed and invalid authentication events per host.

spec.title: Busiest hosts by log volume
spec.description: Top hosts by total log lines.

spec.title: Hosts by volume and errors
spec.description: Log lines, errors and warnings per host.

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (mps_alloy_hostname) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} [$__range])), "metric", "lines", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (mps_alloy_hostname) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)error|failed|failure|fatal|panic" [$__range])), "metric", "errors", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (mps_alloy_hostname) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)warn" [$__range])), "metric", "warnings", "__name__", ".*")

spec.title: Sources by volume and errors
spec.description: Log lines, errors and warnings per source.

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} [$__range])), "metric", "lines", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)error|failed|failure|fatal|panic" [$__range])), "metric", "errors", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~".+", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)warn" [$__range])), "metric", "warnings", "__name__", ".*")
count(sum by (module) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range])))
count(sum by (mps_alloy_hostname) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range])))
sum by (mps_alloy_hostname) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__interval]))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (module) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, module) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "dest=(?P<dest>[^ ]+)" | dest!="" [$__range]))))
topk(8, sum by (module) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Tasks by host and module
spec.description: Task counts per host and module.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, module) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "(?P<module>ansible-[^:]+): Invoked with (?P<args>.*)" | module!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({job="syslog-user.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "dest=(?P<dest>[^ ]+)" | dest!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Ansible activity
spec.description: All user.log lines (filter with the Search box).

spec.expr: count(sum by (cmd) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range])))
count(sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Cron runs
spec.description: Cron executions and sessions per interval.

spec.expr: count(sum by (cmd) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__interval])))

spec.title: Top users
spec.description: Users running the most cron jobs.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (exe) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<exe>\S+)` | exe!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (cmd) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Runs by user
spec.description: Share of cron runs per user.

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range])))

sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (user, cmd) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<cmd>.*)\)` | user!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (user, exe) (count_over_time({job="syslog-cron.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `CRON\[\d+\]: \((?P<user>[^)]+)\) CMD \((?P<exe>\S+)` | exe!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Cron logs
spec.description: All cron lines (filter with the Search box).

spec.title: Error rate
spec.description: Percentage of lines that are errors.

spec.title: Log volume vs errors
spec.description: Container log volume and error count per interval.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (component) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `component=(?P<component>\S+)` | component!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (component) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "level=error" | regexp `component=(?P<component>\S+)` | component!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (logger) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `logger=(?P<logger>\S+)` | logger!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(8, sum by (component) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "level=error" | regexp `component=(?P<component>\S+)` | component!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (msg) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "level=error" | regexp `msg="(?P<msg>[^"]+)"` | msg!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (component, caller) (count_over_time({job="docker", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "level=error" | regexp `caller=(?P<caller>\S+) component=(?P<component>\S+)` | component!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Container error lines (filter with the Search box).

spec.title: All container logs
spec.description: All container logs (filter with the Search box).

spec.title: Bans
spec.description: IPs banned in the selected time range.

spec.title: Unbans
spec.description: IPs unbanned (bantime expired or manual unban).

spec.title: Unique offending IPs
spec.description: Distinct IPs that triggered at least one failure.

spec.expr: count(sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] (Ban|Unban) " | regexp `fail2ban\.actions\s+\[\d+\]:\s+NOTICE\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?P<action>Ban|Unban)\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" | action="Ban" [$__range])))

spec.title: Fail2ban activity
spec.description: Ban, unban and found events per interval.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] (Ban|Unban) " | regexp `fail2ban\.actions\s+\[\d+\]:\s+NOTICE\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?P<action>Ban|Unban)\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" | action="Ban" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Top 10 offenders
spec.description: IPs with the most failure events.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "Found " | regexp `fail2ban\.filter\s+\[\d+\]:\s+INFO\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+Found\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (jail) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] (Ban|Unban) " | regexp `fail2ban\.actions\s+\[\d+\]:\s+NOTICE\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?P<action>Ban|Unban)\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" [$__range]))))

sum by (jail) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] (Ban|Unban) " | regexp `fail2ban\.actions\s+\[\d+\]:\s+NOTICE\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?P<action>Ban|Unban)\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" | action="Ban" [$__range]))

spec.title: Bans by IP and jail
spec.description: Most frequently banned IPs per jail.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (ip, jail) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "] (Ban|Unban) " | regexp `fail2ban\.actions\s+\[\d+\]:\s+NOTICE\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?P<action>Ban|Unban)\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" | action="Ban" [$__range])))

spec.title: Failed attempts by IP and jail

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (ip, jail) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "Found " | regexp `fail2ban\.filter\s+\[\d+\]:\s+INFO\s+\[(?P<jail>[^\]]+)\]\s+Found\s+(?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Fail2ban logs
spec.description: All fail2ban log lines. Type in the Search box above to filter.

spec.title: Kernel events
spec.description: Kernel volume and errors per interval.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (subsys) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "kernel: (?P<subsys>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+):" | subsys!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Top interfaces
spec.description: Network interfaces with the most messages.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (iface) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "kernel: (?P<iface>eth[0-9]+|br-[0-9a-f]+|veth[0-9a-f]+)" | iface!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (subsys) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)error|failed|fail|panic|oops" | regexp "kernel: (?P<subsys>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+):" | subsys!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Events by subsystem
spec.description: Share of kernel events by subsystem.

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (subsys) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "kernel: (?P<subsys>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+):" | subsys!="" [$__range])))
sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (subsys) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp "kernel: (?P<subsys>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+):" | subsys!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (subsys) (count_over_time({job="syslog-kern.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)error|failed|fail|panic|oops" | regexp "kernel: (?P<subsys>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+):" | subsys!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Kernel errors
spec.description: Kernel errors (filter with the Search box).

spec.title: All kernel logs
spec.description: All kernel lines (filter with the Search box).

spec.title: Accepted logins
spec.description: Successful SSH authentications in the selected time range (password or public key).

spec.title: Failed passwords
spec.description: Every 'Failed password' line, including attempts for valid and invalid users.

spec.title: Invalid users
spec.description: Attempts using a username that does not exist on the host.

spec.title: Unique attacker IPs
spec.description: Distinct source IPs that produced at least one failed password.

spec.expr: count(sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | __error__="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Root account attacks
spec.description: Failed password attempts targeting the root account specifically.

spec.title: Accepted root logins
spec.description: Successful root logins. Any value above zero is highlighted.

spec.title: Authentication activity
spec.description: Authentication events per interval, split by class.

spec.title: Unique attacker IPs
spec.description: Number of distinct source IPs that failed at least once per interval.

spec.expr: count(sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | __error__="" [$__interval])))

spec.title: Top 10 attacking IPs
spec.description: Top 10 source IPs by number of failed passwords.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | __error__="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Top 10 targeted users
spec.description: Top 10 usernames targeted by failed passwords.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | __error__="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Accepted auth methods
spec.description: Breakdown of successful authentications by method.

spec.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |~ "Accepted (password|publickey)" | pattern `<_> Accepted <method> for <_> from <_>` | __error__="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Top 10 successful users
spec.description: Top 10 users with the most successful logins.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |~ "Accepted (password|publickey)" | pattern `<_> Accepted <_> for <user> from <_>` | __error__="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Failed logins by user and IP
spec.description: Failed password attempts aggregated by username and source IP.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (user, src_ip) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | __error__="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Successful logins by user, IP and method
spec.description: Successful logins aggregated by username, source IP and authentication method.

spec.expr: sum by (user, src_ip, method) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sshd" |~ "Accepted (password|publickey)" | pattern `<_> Accepted <method> for <user> from <src_ip> port <_>` | __error__="" [$__range]))

spec.title: SSH logs
spec.description: All sshd activity. Type in the Search box above to filter these log lines.

spec.title: Commands executed
spec.description: Successful sudo command executions (incorrect-password and policy-violation lines excluded).

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Incorrect password events
spec.description: Lines reporting N incorrect password attempts.

spec.title: Policy violations
spec.description: Commands rejected by sudo policy (command not allowed).

spec.title: Interactive shells via sudo
spec.description: Privilege-escalation watch: shells spawned through sudo without -c.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" | exe=~"(^|/)(su|bash|zsh|dash|ash|sh)$" | args!~"-c" [$__range]))

spec.title: Sudo activity
spec.description: Sudo events per interval, split by class.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Unique sudo users
spec.description: Number of distinct users invoking sudo per interval.

spec.expr: count(sum by (submituser) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__interval])))

spec.title: Top 10 sudo users
spec.description: Users that executed the most sudo commands.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (submituser) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Top 10 target users
spec.description: Target accounts most often assumed via sudo.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (target) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (exe) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Commands (share)
spec.description: Share of executed sudo commands by executable.

spec.expr: sum by (exe) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Top commands by user and target
spec.description: Most frequent user / target / command combinations.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (submituser, target, exe, args) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "COMMAND=" |~ "$ansible" != "command not allowed" != "incorrect password attempts" | regexp `sudo:\s+(?P<submituser>\S+) : (?:TTY=\S+ ; )?PWD=\S+ ; USER=(?P<target>\S+) ; COMMAND=(?P<exe>\S+)(?P<args>.*)` | submituser!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Sudo sessions by invoker and target
spec.description: Who opened privilege sessions for which target account.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (invoker, target) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "sudo" |= "session opened for user" | pattern `<_> sudo: pam_unix(sudo:session): session opened for user <target>(<_>) by <invoker>(<_>)` | invoker!="" [$__range])))

spec.title: Sudo logs
spec.description: All sudo log lines. Type in the Search box above to filter. The Ansible toggle does not affect this panel.

spec.title: Errors vs warnings
spec.description: Error, warning and unit-failure counts per interval.

spec.title: Top processes by errors
spec.description: Processes generating the most error lines.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (process) (count_over_time({job="syslog-syslog", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ "(?i)error|failed|failure|fatal|panic" | regexp `^(?P<ts>\S+) (?P<host>\S+) (?P<process>[^\s\[:]+)` | process!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (process) (count_over_time({job="syslog-syslog", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} | regexp `^(?P<ts>\S+) (?P<host>\S+) (?P<process>[^\s\[:]+)` | process!="" [$__range]))))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (process) (count_over_time({job="syslog-syslog", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"} |= "Failed with result" | regexp `^(?P<ts>\S+) (?P<host>\S+) (?P<process>[^\s\[:]+)` | process!="" [$__range]))))
